name: Cornelia Roberts
source:
Part of [url=https://vndb.org/c174079]Sayaka[/url]'s friend group. She's somewhat clingy and desperate for approval, causing her to always hang by Sayaka's side parroting her every opinion. Her small stature is a sensitive subject for her, but it also makes her an excellent flier on the cheerleading squad.
